descriptions.sol35f9_string_tree_hint_8035a6f8: Use a bidirectional iterator hint in the observed GC32 string-key ordered tree: check leftmost/end/interior positions, compare native string keys, use adjacent gaps when valid, preserve equal entries and otherwise forward to unique insertion. Native iterator/result return ABI and all strcmp, traversal, unique-insertion and node-insertion identities are witnessed by original instructions. Class names and STL identity inferred; external string/value ownership and tree lifetimes remain preconditions.
